title: Resilience
statement: For a Boolean function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional sign cube and a natural number $k$, resilience means that $f$ is correlation immune with parameter $k$ and that its real-valued version is balanced.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube.
caveat: The payload does not define correlation immunity or balance, so their precise meanings cannot be rendered from the supplied information.
